text:
Maria D.: NA-east app metrics just jumped — p50/p95 for gen endpoints +5x at 13:02 UTC
Zack H.: confirmed, requests queueing on the serving layer, GPU utilization low but request latency high
Anamika R.: logs show huge prefix-cache miss storms from a small traffic shard, eviction rate went through the roof
infra-bot: ALERT: na-east1 prefix-cache eviction rate 87% -> 91% (13:03 UTC)
Lee P.: can we do an emergency traffic diversion to na-west1 while we triage? impact on cost?
Maria D.: yes, start with 20% shift, escalate if no improvement. I'll coordinate rollout
Zack H.: initiating traffic shift: `POST /traffic/shift {"from":"na-east1","to":"na-west1","pct":20}` 
Anamika R.: root cause looks like cache-worker OOMs + slow backend writes causing eviction churn. repro in logs: 
```
prefixcache: worker panic: runtime: out of memory
stack: goroutine 42 [running]:
```
Maria D.: thanks. Can we temp-bypass prefix-cache for gen routes to stop cold-opening chains?
Lee P.: yep — flip `prefix_cache.bypass=true` for `model-type:gen` on na-east. That will increase token costs but reduce latency spikes
Zack H.: bypass toggle applied (rollout id: r-6123)
infra-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: `prefix_cache.bypass` set for route gen on na-east1 by Zack H. (13:08 UTC)
Anamika R.: scaling cache workers + bumping memory for those pods now (from 4G -> 8G)
Maria D.: monitoring: p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 300ms within 60s of bypass + initial traffic shift. Good signal
Lee P.: continue shifting to 50% over next 10m if p95 stays <500ms
Zack H.: increasing to 50% now
Maria D.: ops plan: 1) keep bypass until cache worker memory fix deployed 2) roll hotfix to cache worker (fix GC pressure) 3) revert bypass after health stable
Anamika R.: patch branch created (fix/prefix-gc-stabilize), running canary with 3 pods in na-east
infra-bot: DEPLOY: canary deploy fix/prefix-gc-stabilize -> cache-worker (3 pods) by Anamika R.
Zack H.: observed canary pods stable, mem profile looks better, eviction rate down to 12%
Maria D.: nice. start gradual rollout of fix to remaining cache workers
Lee P.: cost note: bypass + cross-region traffic increased egress and token compute — estimate +18% on hourly ops spend while bypassed
Maria D.: acknowledge. prioritize reliability. We can revert traffic after full rollout and stable metrics
infra-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Incident opened #INC-2026-042 (region: na-east1, cause: prefix-cache OOM/regression). Status: mitigated -> in monitoring
Maria D.: thanks team. postmortem assignee: Anamika R. I'll draft timeline. Closing thread for active steps, keep monitoring for 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
